class.name: TerrainSplatmap
class.brief_description: Four normalized texture-layer weights for heightmap terrain.
class.description: Stores four texture blend weights per grid sample in a [PackedColorArray], mapped to the red, green, blue, and alpha channels. Each weight must be nonnegative, finite, and the four channels must sum to one. Layer 0 starts at full weight. Assign to [member HeightmapTerrain3D.splatmap] and provide texture resources to the terrain node's four layer properties. In the editor, choose a texture layer brush to paint weights with radial falloff. [b]Note:[/b] The data resolution matches [TerrainHeightmap]. New cells default to layer 0; values are stored as floating-point colors but the GPU upload quantizes them to 8-bit RGBA.

method.name: get_layer_weight
method.description: Returns the weight for layer 0–3 at the given grid sample.

method.name: get_weights_at
method.description: Returns the RGBA blend weights at the specified grid position.

method.name: paint_layer
method.description: Paints the chosen layer, blending it with existing normalized weights using linear radial falloff. Other weights are reduced proportionally. Strength is clamped to the interval 0–1 and radius is in terrain grid cells.

method.name: set_dimensions
method.description: Resizes the sample grid while retaining weights within the overlapping region.

method.name: to_image
method.description: Creates an [Image] in RGBA8 format containing the current blend weights. The result can be used as a shader mask or exported for inspection.
